name: Face-swap and face-edit checks
corpus: synthetic photo-like scenes generated from fixed seeds (forensic.validation.run.scene)

detection.task: Does a marked face region differ in noise or detail from the rest of the image?
detection.positives: 80 scenes with sensor-like noise; a 70-110 x 90-130 px region replaced by a smoothed copy
detection.negatives: the same region left untouched in the same 80 scenes

known_failure_modes: Detects a region whose noise or detail differs from the rest; a swap whose noise was matched to the image (see 'smoothed, noise re-added') or a whole re-encoded deepfake video can pass.
Make-up, focus on the face, motion blur and phone beautification also change local detail: a flag is a reason to look, not a conclusion.
Synthetic scenes with rectangular regions; no real face swaps were available for this card.
